observations.trace: The geographic surface chooses the same lower and upper vertex index triples as the regional mesh, excludes triangles with missing vertices, and searches adjacent cells for shared grid edges. RegionalTerrain admits exactly65*65 entries; its five scale spacings are strictly positive. PathMeshBuilder clips to the grid and inserts knots at integral east, north and diagonal boundaries before calling the midpoint-selected surface segment.
observations.remaining: Rounding, edge degeneracy, city segment path, all route callers and native mesh behavior remain open. No actual samples, vectors, triangles or route were generated.

observations.trace: Map markers retain typed StrategicPlaceId and use ground_position and the actual camera viewport; native screen coordinates and human names remain boundary representations. The module reuses pose on an Open command with the same source and home and changes rect only; Hide sets rect None. The surface renderer uses active tactical weather and grass pigment and replaces old mesh/material after building a new source/window/weather/grass combination.

conditional_findings.canonical_owner: RegionalEnvironment product identity and the presented surface, connection and route caches that consume its terrain and connections.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: If an admitted replacement has the same source/window identifiers but different product content, retained presentation and newly installed query data need a shared invalidation or an enforced producer immutability contract.
conditional_findings.trace: RegionalTerrain::new checks the 65-by-65 vertex count, and RegionalEnvironment::new accepts that terrain plus bounded connections. The checked elevation owner admits both0m and10m; EnvironmentalSample has an admitted default. At the type boundary, two conceptual complete flat grids at those heights can carry the same SourcePackageDigest and request. MapCommand::InstallEnvironment replaces state.environment when its source matches the pose; on a later present call with unchanged source, request, weather and grass, surface::present returns without rebuilding. With city invisible, ground_position and marker projection read the newly installed terrain while the retained surface still reflects the earlier terrain. Connection and route caches similarly compare request/source and selected other inputs rather than the whole environment payload.
conditional_findings.producer_qualification: The inspected normal HTTP producer checks the source against the loaded TerrainPack digest and captures that pack for the requested grid; the RoadPack is separately admitted against the terrain digest and retained. Browser request code caches by source/scale/origin and does not reinstall a resident key on the ordinary path. These safeguards narrow the hypothetical: source code inspected here does not establish that the normal producer ever returns different content for a single key, nor that arbitrary bridge clients are trusted or supported. The HTTP source comments that an immutable URL would need a sampling revision; this is a source comment, not evidence of a live version change.
conditional_findings.safeguards: The two grids are a symbolic constructor-level example, not built values, decoded payloads, a claim of source-pack provenance, an observed marker or rendered artifact. The stale outcome requires a first presented product, a later same-key different admitted product, unchanged weather/grass, and the specified scheduler/owner conditions. Valid producer immutability, package lifecycle, road and sampling versioning, direct bridge trust and all cache consumers remain open.
